data_gaps_detail.item_en: GS UK CAI, GS-MAP, GS Surprise Index, and official GS FCI
data_gaps_detail.item_zh: GS UK CAI、GS-MAP、GS Surprise Index与官方GS FCI
data_gaps_detail.status_en: Proprietary GS products. This page charts public components only, including ONS monthly GDP MoM, industrial/services output YoY, and retail-sales YoY/MoM derived from official level series.
data_gaps_detail.status_zh: GS专有产品；本页只绘制公开可复跑组成项，包括由官方水平序列派生的ONS月度GDP环比、工业/服务产出同比，以及零售销售同比/环比。

data_gaps_detail.item_en: Manufacturing, construction, services, and composite PMI
data_gaps_detail.item_zh: 制造业、建筑业、服务业与综合PMI
data_gaps_detail.status_en: Important in the GS framework, but not yet wired because S&P Global PMI history is vendor-controlled.
data_gaps_detail.status_zh: 在GS框架中很重要，但S&P Global PMI历史数据受供应商控制，暂未接入。

data_gaps_detail.item_en: CBI Distributive Trades, CBI Industrial Trends, BCC QES, BRC/KPMG Retail Sales Monitor
data_gaps_detail.item_zh: CBI分销贸易、CBI工业趋势、BCC QES、BRC/KPMG零售销售监测
data_gaps_detail.status_en: Survey sources need separate adapters and licensing checks.
data_gaps_detail.status_zh: 调查源需要单独adapter并核验授权。

data_gaps_detail.item_en: Nationwide, Halifax, Rightmove, Hometrack, and RICS
data_gaps_detail.status_en: ONS/HMLR UK HPI, HMRC property transactions, MHCLG starts/completions, ONS construction output level and YoY growth, and BoE mortgage approvals are now charted; vendor house-price and sentiment sources still need licensing/API validation.
data_gaps_detail.status_zh: ONS/HMLR英国HPI、HMRC物业成交、MHCLG开工/竣工、ONS建筑产出水平和同比、BoE按揭批准已接入；供应商房价和情绪数据仍需授权/API验证。

data_gaps_detail.status_en: ONS inactivity, redundancy level/rate, vacancies, hours, employment, unemployment, AWE, and ONS/HMRC PAYE RTI employees/pay/flows are now charted; pay-settlement series still need stable release-table mappings or survey/licensing checks.
data_gaps_detail.status_zh: ONS经济不活跃率、裁员人数/裁员率、职位空缺、工时、就业、失业、AWE，以及ONS/HMRC PAYE RTI雇员/薪资/流动已接入；工资协议序列仍需稳定发布表映射或调查/授权核验。

data_gaps_detail.item_en: Inflation expectations surveys and index-linked gilt breakevens
data_gaps_detail.item_zh: 通胀预期调查与指数挂钩国债隐含通胀
data_gaps_detail.status_en: ONS headline/core/services/goods/food/household-energy CPI, CPIH and owner-occupiers' housing costs, RPI/RPIX, PPI output inflation derived from the index, and DESNZ petrol/diesel pump prices are now charted; expectations and breakeven series still need stable license-safe mappings.
data_gaps_detail.status_zh: ONS整体/核心/服务/商品/食品/家庭能源CPI、CPIH与自有住房成本、RPI/RPIX、由指数派生的PPI产出同比，以及DESNZ汽油/柴油泵价已接入；通胀预期和盈亏平衡通胀仍需稳定且授权安全的映射。

data_gaps_detail.item_en: Trends in Lending, Credit Conditions Survey, HEW, fuller quoted-rate matrix, and stale OECD 3M interbank mirror
data_gaps_detail.item_zh: Trends in Lending、信贷条件调查、住房权益提取、更完整报价利率矩阵，以及滞后的OECD 3M银行间利率镜像
data_gaps_detail.status_en: BoE IADB now covers Bank Rate, SONIA, sterling, 5Y/10Y nominal gilt par yields, M4, consumer credit, mortgage approvals, and one quoted-rate series. The lagged FRED/OECD 3M interbank mirror is intentionally not charted; use SONIA/Bank Rate for the short-rate channel until a validated BoE or market-data 3M term source is wired.
data_gaps_detail.status_zh: BoE IADB已覆盖Bank Rate、SONIA、英镑、5年/10年名义国债平价收益率、M4、消费信贷、按揭批准和一条报价利率。滞后的FRED/OECD 3M银行间利率镜像不会作为图表展示；在接入经验证的BoE或市场数据3M期限利率前，短端利率渠道使用SONIA/Bank Rate。

data_gaps_detail.item_en: OBR forecast vintages and deeper debt instrument breakdowns
data_gaps_detail.item_zh: OBR预测版本与更深层债务工具细分
data_gaps_detail.status_en: Monthly PSNB, PSNCR, PSND, PSNFL, PSND ex BoE, receipts, expenditure, income/wealth taxes, social benefits, and TME are charted from ONS; core March 2026 OBR forecast rows for borrowing, PSND ex BoE, debt interest, and effective interest rates are now charted. Full vintage archive and instrument-level history still need deeper adapters.
data_gaps_detail.status_zh: 月度PSNB、PSNCR、PSND、PSNFL、不含BoE的PSND、收入、支出、所得与财富税、社会福利和TME已接入ONS；March 2026 OBR核心预测行，包括借款、不含BoE净债务、债务利息和有效利率，已绘图。完整预测版本库和工具级历史仍需更深adapter。
